header.name: ElectroAlka
header.authors_and_contributors: Meire Ribeiro Domingos, Daniel Flórez-Orrego, EPFL IPESE research group
header.reference_capacity: 111.1 kg/h of hydrogen from 1,000 kg/h of water (massflowH2O), 6,111.1 kW of electricity
header.description: Alkaline water electrolyzer producing hydrogen and oxygen from liquid water at 80 to 90 °C, with compressors that bring the oxygen to 30 bar for the process or to 200 bar for export.

units.unit_description: This unit is an alkaline water electrolyzer operating at 80 to 90 °C. At its reference size it splits 1,000.0 kg/h of water into 111.1 kg/h of hydrogen and 888.9 kg/h of oxygen, with 6,111.1 kW of electricity.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes water and electricity, and delivers hydrogen and oxygen at 1 bar. The oxygen goes to the oxyvent layer, from which it is vented or compressed by one of the two oxygen compressors.

connectors.name: OXYVENT
connectors.description: Oxygen produced, to be vented or compressed

units.heat_streams_description: The cooling duty of the electrolyzer system is released between 80 and 30 °C.

heat_streams.name: Heat_AlkaElec
heat_streams.description: Cooling of the electrolyzer system from 80 to 30 °C

units.equipments_description: One electrolyzer, whose investment cost is proportional to its electricity consumption.

CAPEX.full_name: Total investment cost for ref. size

impact.full_name: Scope 3 environmental impact per unit of ref. size

units.unit_description: This unit compresses the oxygen of the electrolyzer, 888.9 kg/h at its reference size, from 1 to 30 bar in three intercooled stages, for use in the process. It takes 103.1 kW of electricity.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes oxygen at 1 bar and electricity, and delivers oxygen at 30 bar to the process.

connectors.name: OXYPROCESS
connectors.description: Oxygen at 30 bar to the process

units.heat_streams_description: Each of the three intercoolers cools the oxygen to 30 °C.

units.unit_description: This unit compresses the oxygen of the electrolyzer, 888.9 kg/h at its reference size, from 1 to 200 bar in six intercooled stages, for export. It takes 155.5 kW of electricity.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes oxygen at 1 bar and electricity, and delivers oxygen at 200 bar for export.
units.heat_streams_description: Each of the six intercoolers cools the oxygen to 30 °C: the three stages to 30 bar, as in the compressor to the process, and three more to 200 bar.
